text:
Alex: quick note — I instrumented KV reuse across routes and we have a weird pattern: cross-request reuse for shared prefixes drops ~30% when a session hops between routes.
Alex: current key scheme is `cache_key = f\"{tenant}:{route}:{prefix_hash}\"` — that `route` field seems to be fragmenting a lot of otherwise identical prefixes.
Maria: link to telemetry? can you paste the small numbers so we can compare
Alex: pasted snapshot from last hour (short):
```
requests: 18.2k
unique_prefixes: 4.5k
avg_hit_rate: 64.1% -> 44.7% (after route bounce)
memory_gb: 312 -> 356 (longctx growth)
p99_tokens_ms: 198 -> 233
```
Sam: my hunch is route-level namespacing is too strict. It prevents reuse when e.g. the same user switches from /chat to /assist endpoints. we should consider a controlled handoff so the same tenant's prefixes can be reused across routes.
Jen: agree we need reuse but watch out for cross-tenant leakage. tenant must always be part of the key. any relaxation should be for route only (and gated).
Alex: proposal A: make `route` optional in the key when a per-session handshake token is present. key becomes `tenant:{maybe_route}:{prefix_hash}:{handshake}` where `maybe_route` omitted if handshake=true. handshake scoped to (tenant, session_id) and short-lived.
kv-bot: experiment pushed: `shared-prefix-handshake=v1` at 2026-03-17T03:12:00Z — quick readout: handshake=on => hit_rate +12.3%, p99 -8.1%, memory +1.9% (expected, more residency)
Maria: can we run the longctx stress (6h) with and without handshake? please run `./tools/kv-bench --profile shared-prefix --duration 6h --longctx` and attach summary.
Sam: i'll run baseline tonight and then handshake variant tomorrow. question: eviction TTLs currently uniform 10m. if handshake keeps prefixes alive we may need adaptive ttl per-prefix frequency.
Alex: yep — add adaptive TTL experiment: hot-prefix TTL = min(60m, 10m * hit_multiplier). also try allowing a short grace TTL when route hops are detected.
Jen: also add audit events for when handshake causes cross-route reuse (for SOC/compliance), simple event: `kv.HandshakeUsed tenant route_from route_to prefix_hash session_id` — log to audit stream.
Maria: sgtm :thumbsup:
Alex: experiment matrix (owners):
- baseline (Sam)
- handshake-on (Sam)
- handshake+adaptive-ttl (Alex)
- handshake+audit-only (Jen)
I'll post run links and perf diffs in #eng-runtime once done.
Maria: thanks — prioritize the longctx run, that's where we saw memory drift last month.
